# Borchardt Construction Technology

> Borchardt Construction Technology (BCT) provides construction drafting and field-ready construction data services.

Canonical website: https://borchardtct.com

## Services

- 3D machine-control and rover site models structured around project plans, grading surfaces, and equipment workflows.
- Site takeoffs for earthwork, paving, concrete, pipe, and associated materials from approved project files.
- Construction drafting prepared around an agreed project scope and deliverable format.
- 3D land, grading, terrain, and surface modeling from approved project files.
- Drone progress and surface-data processing workflows.
- GPS rover setup, troubleshooting, calibration, localization, control, and crew training for supported systems.

## Source and review status

- Service details are limited to statements published on the BCT website or approved for its launch draft.
- Locations, equipment-brand compatibility, certifications, project results, reviews, and company history require owner approval before publication.
- The website is the canonical source for current BCT service information.
